summary: Ambev S.A. furnished a routine Form 6-K (a non-US issuer's equivalent of a current report) containing three consolidated Article 11 CVM Instruction 44/2021 forms covering management and related-person securities transactions for August 1-31, 2026. Board holdings stayed flat at 30,679,627 common shares; management reported a removal-from-office transfer of 414,208 common shares and 19,790 ADRs at zero price, ending at 3,087,593 common shares, while the fiscal council held 2,500 shares unchanged. No special-situation event, pricing, premium, recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are disclosed.
